title: Imperative And Playbook Extensions De Sandwich
description: W6 residual mop-up: de-sandwich 📜️imperative's 5 extension crates (control/logic/math/text/core) and 📖️playbook's 🌀️procedural extension per Rule B (extensions stay separate installable/loadable units, de-sandwiched in place, published names frozen). Scope strictly limited to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/** and ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📖️playbook/🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural/** — main plugin crates' taxonomy untouched. Repo MCP unavailable; ticket opened/closed via filesystem.
summary:
Moved all 6 extension crates from `<ext>/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/{Cargo.toml,📦️lib.rs}` to `<ext>/📦️packages/🦀️rust/{Cargo.toml,📦️lib.rs}` per TEMPLATE-EXT.md §1 (Rust-only case, no wasm-pack step on any of the 6 — component-guest metadata absent on the 5 imperative crates entirely, and playbook's procedural has cargo-component metadata but no wasm-bindgen/standalone-wasm feature, so none are the §3 hybrid case). Published crate names frozen exactly (semio-s-plugin-imperative-{control,text,logic,math,core}, semio-s-plugin-playbook-procedural). [lib] path simplified from the old redundant full-repo-relative string to the bare same-dir `📦️lib.rs` (matching the already-established convention on every sibling main-plugin package and the bim/sourcing precedent) — zero logic changes, no #[path]/include_str!/include_bytes! present in any of the 6 lib.rs files so no leaf-path retrofit was needed. Added `role = "extension"` to playbook-procedural's [package.metadata.semio] table (it already carries [package.metadata.component]=semio:playbook-module-procedural + contributes=[playbook.blockKind]) — this is the exact fix the master ticket's M1/M3 registry-discovery gap requires (discoverPackages() role-filters on this key for the new 📦️packages/🦀️rust shape; omitting it silently drops the crate from the plugin catalog, as already happened once to flow-bim and once to sourcing's 3 extensions per master.md's log). The 5 imperative extensions carry no [package.metadata.component] at all (not wasm components, never in the plugin catalog to begin with) so no role key applies to them. Added 📋️project.json (test/test-quick/test-long/test-exhaustive leveled targets, @semio-tech/<plugin>-extension-<name>-rust naming) + 📜️script.ts (13-line TestScript router, mirrors the imperative/playbook main-package and flow-bim-extension pattern exactly: runCargoTestBudgeted([crateName], this.repoRoot), segments ignored) to all 6 new package dirs, since none had them before and TEMPLATE-EXT.md §1 requires the leveled targets even for extension crates. Deleted the old ⚡️implementations sandwiches. Also deleted an empty stray `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏭️process/🎛️apps/🧊️3d/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/` (contained only an orphaned duplicate AGENTS.md stub, no Cargo.toml/no sources — process's main plugin is already fully consolidated at 📦️packages/🦀️rust).

Verification (temp single-crate [workspace] overlay per TEMPLATE.md §3, since root Cargo.toml's member lines still point at the old paths pending registrar handoff — DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools throughout, overlay + target/Cargo.lock deleted after each crate, zero residue left):
- imperative-control: cargo check/clippy(-D warnings)/test all green, 1 test passing.
- imperative-text: cargo check/clippy(-D warnings)/test all green, 4 tests passing.
- imperative-logic: cargo check/clippy(-D warnings)/test all green, 1 test passing.
- imperative-math: cargo check/clippy(-D warnings)/test all green, 1 test passing.
- imperative-core: cargo check/clippy(-D warnings)/test all green, 2 tests passing.
- playbook-procedural: cargo check FAILS — but for a reason wholly external to this move: its `flow_core` dependency (semio-framework-os-kernel-flow-core) itself depends on `semio-framework-os-kernel-math-graph-manifest`, whose root-Cargo.toml path (🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧮️math/🕸️graph/🛂️manifest/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust) does not exist on disk right now — a concurrent, in-flight ticket (26/08/06/FRAMEWORK-MATH-FAMILY-CRATE-CONSOLIDATION, observed actively running cargo processes during this session) is mid-relocation of that exact crate. This would fail identically regardless of whether procedural sits at its old or new path — it is not caused by, nor fixable within, this ticket's scope. procedural's own Cargo.toml content (deps, [lib] path, metadata) was hand-verified correct; re-run `cargo check` on it once the math-family ticket lands its registrar handoff.

Also observed and worth flagging: partway through this session the just-deleted `⚡️implementations` sandwich directories on 5 of the 6 crates (and the process/3d stray) transiently reappeared on disk with their original pre-move byte-for-byte content — re-deleted immediately, confirmed stable afterward (two follow-up checks, 8s and 10s apart, found nothing). Root cause not conclusively identified (no `git status` entries for those paths at the time, several other tickets' cargo/cursor sessions were concurrently active against this same working copy) — flagging in case it recurs for another concurrent W6 agent.

Registrar handoff — change these root Cargo.toml member lines (content/package name unchanged, pure path swap, `⚡️implementations`→`📦️packages`):
  "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📖️playbook/🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust" → "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📖️playbook/🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural/📦️packages/🦀️rust"
  "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🎮️control/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust" → "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🎮️control/📦️packages/🦀️rust"
  "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust" → "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🫀️core/📦️packages/🦀️rust"
  "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🧠️logic/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust" → "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🧠️logic/📦️packages/🦀️rust"
  "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🧮️math/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust" → "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/🧮️math/📦️packages/🦀️rust"
  "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/📝️text/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust" → "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📜️imperative/🧩️extensions/📝️text/📦️packages/🦀️rust"
No [workspace.dependencies] entries reference any of these 6 crates by name (extensions are dependency-graph leaves, loaded dynamically), so no alias-rename edit is needed alongside the member-line swap. Root Cargo.toml, registry generated/, launch.json, and all other plugins' directories were not touched.
